//: The docs site is the one package in this repository whose build produces a cacheable artifact, so it is the one package that overrides the root's empty `outputs`. The Python packages go the other way — `cache: false` everywhere, because a Python result depends on the pixi environment and turbo's hash does not cover it (python/turbo.json). Astro's build is a pure function of this directory plus the lockfile, both of which turbo does hash, so the cache is honest here. `.astro/` is listed as an output alongside `dist/` because it holds the generated content-collection types that `astro check` reads; restoring `dist/` from cache without it leaves the next `check` re-syncing from scratch. `dev` cannot be cached and must not be killed when it stops producing output, hence `persistent`.
